text_block_list.text:
Both Фудзи Кисэки and I are at a loss for
how to
overcome the pressure she's
feeling. We watch a
DVD of one of her
mother's performances in the
hopes we
can find a hint.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Surely, even she must feel pressured as a stage actor. But as we watch, she doesn't give off that impression. Фудзи Кисэки can't figure out why.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I suggest we ask her mother directly how
she's
able to keep her cool on stage,
and Фудзи Кисэки
agrees. We settle on a
date to meet her mother.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
